chunks: And Amir al-Mu'minin عليه السلام said:
Indeed, the most deserving of conditions to be fulfilled are those by which you make lawful access to private parts.

key_terms.الْفُرُوجَ: private parts, referring here to lawful marital intimacy

ai.seo_question: Which conditions are most deserving of being fulfilled in marriage contracts?
ai.summary: This hadith emphasizes the binding force of conditions connected to marriage, since they are tied to making intimate relations lawful. It highlights the seriousness of honoring agreed terms in matrimonial contracts and related obligations.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4401 - Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) said:
"Indeed, the most deserving of conditions to be fulfilled are those by which you make lawful access to private parts."
